title: GMO and Non-GMO Labeling Effects: Evidence from a Quasi-Natural Experiment
authors: Aaron Adalja; Jura Liaukonyte; Emily Qixuan Wang; Xinrong Zhu
eligible_reason: No staggered binary design. Section 4.1 (Table 4) regresses non-GMO entrant quantity share on continuous Google Trends SVI with store, brand and quarter FE (continuous regressor). Sections 4.2 and 5 (Figure 7 table, Figure 8 DMA-border table, Table 5) are single-treated-unit DiDs: Vermont vs synthetic-control-weighted counties/Maine, with one common onset (May/June 2013 for the labeling-law information shock, July 2016 for mandatory labeling).
design_notes: Replication.7z (do-files read after extracting only *.do to the scratchpad). entry_reg.do: reghdfe q_noGMO_share_percent avg_score [w=q_cat_store_2014], a(quarter store_code superbrand) plus placebo SVI columns. aftersynth_did.do: Vermont vs synthetic county average, reghdfe q_share_noGMO delta after treated, noabsorb (2 units). dma_test.do: stores in three border DMAs, ddd_coef = Vermont x after(201305), a(store_code month), store-quantity weights, single onset. gmo_effect_synth_countylevel.do / storelevel.do: Vermont vs synthetic control (or Maine stores with synth weights), after = month>=201607, single onset; Table 5 columns 1-8. bootstrap_se.do: Table C6.
n_adoption_cohorts_note: Only Vermont is treated, at one date per analysis.
data_files: Replication.7z: Section 3-5 Data/*.dta (store_before_after_2012-2017, entry_svi, entry_sample_aggregate, synth_sample_ddd_county, sample_ddd_state_weighted_VT, county_month_before_after, data_gmoeffect, countylevel_test_weight, svi_monthly)
data_files_note: Readme.txt: NGPV data under NDA and Nielsen RMS cannot be shared; 'we provide simulated data with random 50% draws from the original data and add a normally distributed random noise. Product and brand names are replaced by random numerical ids.' Noised (fuzzed) data under the protocol.
data_provenance_note: Fuzzed: 50% random draw plus Gaussian noise (same recipe as mksc.2022.1386).
software_notes: Stata reghdfe, synth; R and PowerPoint for figures.
screener_notes: Screened from package only (no article text; regression inventory empty because the code sits in a .7z). Extracted only the .do files with bsdtar into the scratchpad; no data extracted, nothing run. Not eligible on design (continuous SVI or single treated state) and data are fuzzed.
